gate.title: SAML isn't in your plan
gate.description: Upgrade to let people sign in through your identity provider, and to sign them in to SAML apps.

readOnly.title: You can see this connection, not change it
readOnly.description: Changing a connection needs the connection.write permission.

index.title: SAML sign-in
index.description: People sign in through your identity provider: Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace or another.
index.howNote: Qeet ID trusts what your identity provider says about a person, because it signs it.

steps.start: Someone signs in at Qeet ID
steps.startNote: Qeet ID sends them to your identity provider with a sign-in request.
steps.providerNote: With its own password, two-step and rules.
steps.backNote: Qeet ID checks the signature with its certificate, then signs them in by their email.

index.emptyDescription: Start one with your identity provider's details: its metadata, or its sign-in URL and certificate.

notFound.title: Connection not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted. Connections lists every connection.

certificate.endingDescription: From {{date}}, sign-ins through it fail. Get the new certificate from {{provider}} and add it here.

provider.title: Identity provider
provider.note: The service your people sign in with.
provider.name: Name
provider.kindHint: Worked out from its sign-in URL.

ours.title: Give {{provider}} these details
ours.note: Paste them into the SAML app you set up for Qeet ID in {{provider}}.
ours.acsHint: Where {{provider}} sends people back after they sign in.
ours.entityHint: Tells {{provider}} which service it's signing people in to. Also called the audience.
ours.nameIdHint: Qeet ID reads the email from the {{attribute}} attribute, and from the Name ID when it isn't sent.
ours.metadataHint: For a provider that imports a file or URL instead.

theirs.title: {{provider}}'s details
theirs.note: Where to send people, and the certificate that proves a sign-in came from {{provider}}.
theirs.unreadable: Can't be read here: run the checks

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.note: Which parts of {{provider}}'s sign-in response fill each person's profile.
attributes.emailHint: It matches people to their account here; without it, the Name ID is used.
attributes.name: Display name
attributes.nameHint: Their display name when their account is made here.
attributes.newPeopleText: Added to {{org}} the first time they sign in, only for an address on a domain {{org}} has verified. An account already here is linked only if its address is verified and it doesn't administer {{org}}.

turnOn.title: Test and turn on
turnOn.note: The checks read the settings above; nothing is sent to {{provider}}. Test sign-in then goes through {{provider}} for real.

checks.entity: The provider's entity ID is set

means.draft: Being set up: it signs nobody in until you turn it on.
means.disabled: Sign-ins through it are refused. The accounts it made stay.

idpInitiated.title: Started in {{provider}}
idpInitiated.acceptedHint: {{provider}} can also start a sign-in, from its own app list. Every other check still runs, and a response used twice is still refused.
idpInitiated.notAcceptedHint: Only sign-ins that start at Qeet ID are accepted: each response must answer a request Qeet ID sent, in the same browser.
idpInitiated.confirmDescription: {{name}} can then sign people in without a request from Qeet ID. Qeet ID still checks the signature and refuses a response used twice, but can't tie it to the browser that asked.
idpInitiated.acceptAction: Accept sign-ins started by the identity provider
idpInitiated.stopAction: Stop accepting sign-ins started by the identity provider

on.done: {{name}} is on: people can sign in through it

off.title: Turn off {{name}}?
off.description: People can't sign in through {{name}} until you turn it back on. Their accounts stay as they are.

delete.zoneOn: People who sign in through {{name}} will need another way in.
delete.zoneOff: It isn't on, so nobody signs in through it now.
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: People can no longer sign in through {{name}}. Their accounts, groups and roles stay; anyone who signs in only this way needs another way in.

drawer.title: New SAML connection
drawer.description: Your identity provider's details, from its metadata or typed in. It starts as a draft; Qeet ID's own details come on its page next.
drawer.editDescription: Changes apply to the next sign-in.
drawer.name: Name
drawer.metadataHint: Read here: nothing is uploaded. It fills in the sign-in URL, entity ID and certificate.
drawer.metadataFile: An XML file from your identity provider

metadataProblem.invalidXml: That isn't metadata Qeet ID can read.
metadataProblem.missingEntityId: The metadata has no entity ID.
metadataProblem.missingSsoUrl: The metadata has no sign-in URL.
metadataProblem.missingCertificate: The metadata has no signing certificate.
metadataProblem.tooLarge: That file is too large to be metadata.

drawer.ssoUrlHint: Where Qeet ID sends people to sign in. An https:// address.
drawer.certificateHint: PEM, or the base64 from its metadata.
drawer.emailAttributeHint: Leave it empty to use the Name ID.

required.name: Enter a name.
required.entityId: Enter the identity provider's entity ID.
required.ssoUrl: Enter an https:// address with a host.
required.certificate: Paste a certificate Qeet ID can read.

apps.title: SAML apps
apps.description: Qeet ID signs your people in to these apps.
apps.descriptionCounts: Qeet ID signs your people in to these apps · {{on}} on, {{setup}} in setup

ours.title: Give each app Qeet ID's details
ours.note: Most apps import the metadata URL. For one set up by hand, copy the rest.
ours.metadataHint: The app reads everything below from it, and Qeet ID's signing certificate.
ours.entityHint: Also called the issuer or IdP identifier.
ours.ssoHint: Also called the SSO URL. It takes Redirect and POST.
ours.nameIdHint: Every app gets the email address as the Name ID, in the format it asks for.

list.title: Apps
list.note: Anyone in {{org}} with an active account can be signed in to an app that isn't turned off, including one still in setup.
list.emptyDescription: Add one with what the app gave you: its entity ID and where it takes the sign-in response.

off.title: Turn off {{name}}?
off.description: Qeet ID stops signing people in to {{name}} until you turn it back on.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: Qeet ID stops signing people in to {{name}}. Their accounts here stay; they'll need another way into {{name}}.

appDrawer.title: Add an app
appDrawer.description: Copy these from the app's SAML settings. Qeet ID's details are on this page.
appDrawer.editDescription: Changes apply to the next sign-in.
appDrawer.name: Name
appDrawer.entityIdHint: The app's entity ID, or audience. Each app's is different.
appDrawer.acsUrlHint: Where the app takes the sign-in response: https, or http to this computer.
appDrawer.nameIdFormatHint: The format the app asks for. The value is the person's email address either way.

required.name: Enter a name.
required.acsUrl: Enter an https:// address, or http:// to localhost.

toast.signInCreated: SAML connection created, as a draft
